meta.purpose: Per-country financing cost (real pre-tax WACC) and seasonal H2 storage geology used by the v7 model (wacc_mode=country, geology-based storage pricing).
meta.wacc_convention: Values are REAL PRE-TAX WACC screening estimates for utility-scale renewables. Construction: the most recent surveyed NOMINAL POST-TAX WACC per country (AURES II survey 2019/20, Zenodo 5572754; IRENA cost-of-financing 2023 where more recent; DiaCore 2016 only where nothing newer exists - flagged) is used directly as a real pre-tax proxy, on the documented approximation that the ~2 pp rise in the risk-free rate since the survey period offsets the ~2 pp nominal-to-real inflation adjustment, and the post-tax to pre-tax uplift is within the sampling band. A floor of 4.0% (no European infrastructure project currently finances below ~4% real pre-tax) and a cap of 10.0% are applied. UK uses DESNZ 2025 values published directly as real pre-tax; CH uses the SFOE regulated imputed WACC. The wacc_country_delta parameter (+/-1.5 pp) in literature_inputs.json samples around these values. This is a screening table: replace with a single-vintage dataset (e.g. Hatton et al. 2025, Sci Data, Zenodo 17076925) before publication if a uniform source is preferred.
meta.wacc_sources: AURES II: https://zenodo.org/records/5572754 and https://www.isi.fraunhofer.de/content/dam/isi/dokumente/ccx/2021/AURES_II_D5_2_financing_conditions.pdf ; IRENA cost of financing 2023: https://www.irena.org/-/media/Files/IRENA/Agency/Publication/2023/May/IRENA_The_cost_of_financing_renewable_power_2023.pdf ; DiaCore: https://www.isi.fraunhofer.de/content/dam/isi/dokumente/ccx/dia-core/D3-4_diacore_2016_impact_of_risk_in_res_investments.pdf ; UK DESNZ: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/68ba91f411b4ded2da19fe92/onshore-wind-and-solar-pv-cost-electricity-report-update-2024.pdf ; CH SFOE: https://www.bfe.admin.ch/bfe/en/home/promotion/renewable-energy/wacc-imputed-interest-rate.html ; MENA: https://one.oecd.org/document/ENV/WKP(2024)15/REV1/en/pdf and IRENA RPGC 2024.
meta.h2_geology_convention: salt = onshore salt-cavern potential exists (seasonal H2 store priced at h2_storage_capex_cavern_chf_per_kwh); rock = no salt deposits, lined rock cavern assumed (h2_storage_capex_rock_chf_per_kwh). Assignment follows Caglayan et al. 2020 (IJHE 45:6793-6805, onshore technical potential): salt-cavern countries Germany, Netherlands, UK, Poland, Denmark, France, Spain, Portugal, Romania, Greece. Elberry et al. 2021 confirm no salt potential in Finland/Sweden. Site-to-cavern distance is NOT modelled (screening limitation - the store is assumed co-located).
